title: Pressure of B (first step)
description: Essential: Correctly applies Boyle's Law to gas B to find its pressure after compression to V/2.

title: Volume of A (first step)
description: Essential: Correctly solves for the volume of A using Boyle's Law for A and the pressure difference condition (p_A = p_B + 0.5p_0).

title: Boyle's Law application
description: Important: Recognizes and correctly applies Boyle's Law (pV = constant) for both gases in all isothermal steps.

title: Pressure difference condition
description: Important: Correctly uses the condition that the partition slides when the pressure difference exceeds 0.5p_0 to relate p_A and p_B.

title: Volume constraint (return step)
description: Important: Applies the total volume constraint (V_A' + V_B' = 2V) when the piston returns to its initial position.

title: Final A volume and B pressure
description: Essential: Correctly solves the system of equations for the final volume of A and pressure of B after the piston returns.

title: Algebraic solution accuracy
description: Optional: Correctly handles the algebra to obtain the exact forms (e.g., involving √5) or correct decimal equivalents.

title: Sign error in pressure relation
description: Pitfall: Uses the wrong sign in the pressure-difference relation (e.g., p_A = p_B - 0.5p_0) for the first or second step.

title: Misapplies partition condition
description: Pitfall: Assumes the partition is always stationary or always sliding, failing to check the pressure difference condition correctly.
